name: comp-342

frames.best_why: Third row is expanded showing its body text, with all four icon rows and chevrons visible.

tagline: Rows with round icons and a second line of grey text fold open one at a time.
summary: A four-row accordion for account settings. Each row has a circular icon, a bold title and a grey subtitle; clicking a row opens its paragraph and closes the one before.
appearance: A four-row list under a bold heading. Each row starts with a small grey icon inside a thin circular outline, then a bold title with a grey subtitle beneath, and a downward chevron at the right edge. Thin dividers separate rows, and the open row shows an indented paragraph of muted text.
behaviour: Clicking a row expands its paragraph with a short height animation, rotates its chevron upward and closes any other open row. The third row starts open; clicking it again collapses it.
demo_content: Heading 'W/ icon, sub-header, and chevron'; rows about accounts, notifications, 2-step verification and support.
search_phrases: list rows that expand one at a time
settings sections with icons and subtitles
click a row to reveal hidden text
fold out rows with secondary labels
show and hide paragraphs in a list
use_when: Grouping related settings or FAQ answers so only one explanation is open at a time.
avoid_when: Rows are text-height with muted body copy, which can be hard to read and tap on small screens.
customise: Rows, icons, titles, subtitles and paragraph copy all live in one array in the file, so editing them means editing the source; styling comes from utility classes.
weight_why: Four short rows and a height and chevron transition; nothing runs in the background.

a11y.note: Triggers are real buttons with visible focus rings and icon decoration hidden from screen readers; there is no reduced-motion check.

issues: The demo heading 'W/ icon, sub-header, and chevron' reads like a build note, not user copy.
Muted body text is low contrast on the dark background.
polish_why: Clean, consistent rows; the developer-style heading and faint body text weaken it.
